title: Simulations of Coronal Mass Ejections on the star ε Eridani

evidence.locator: Record description: BATS-R-US AWSoM simulations of eruptions on ε Eridani at the 10 minute post-eruption mark, Tecplot binary, with the variable list; version v 0.1; licence CC BY 4.0; one file of 6,355,199,342 bytes
Sections I and II: the magnetic maps of January 2008, October 2011 and October 2013 (Jeffers et al. 2014) as boundary conditions; eruptions at latitude +10° and ±70°

statements.text: Ó Fionnagáin, Kavanagh, Vidotto et al. (2022), ApJ 924, 115, doi:10.3847/1538-4357/ac35de; data doi:10.5281/zenodo.5575241

statements.scope: The deposited files and display derivatives of them

statements.text: The deposit holds each simulation ten minutes after a modelled eruption, not the steady state the eruption starts from; the authors offer the full set on request.
